summary: SAMA is a self-hosted chat server packaged with corresponding client applications. It provides a private communication environment that you can run on your own infrastructure under the GPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: It suits administrators who want to deploy a custom, self-hosted messaging setup using containerised infrastructure.
watchOut: With a low maintenance score and a modest community following, you may encounter unresolved bugs or lack rapid security patches for edge cases.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
